'''Wizzich Mozzer''' was a [[Cyclorrian]] who served the [[Resistance]] alongside the rest of his swarm during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] with the [[First Order]]. Uncharacteristically inquisitive and independent, Mozzer was interested in interacting with non-Cyclorrians, and also learned [[sabacc]], spreading the knowledge throughout the swarm. In [[35 ABY]], he was stationed at the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]].

==Biography==
Wizzich Mozzer was a [[Cyclorrian]] who was part of a swarm of Cyclorrians that committed itself to the [[Resistance]] and served with them during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. Mozzer worked as a [[technician]] for the Resistance and was stationed at their base on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

During his service, he learned [[sabacc]] from other Resistance personnel and began spreading it through out the swarm. This bothered the taskmaster [[Vazzet Dipterz]], but he allowed it as long as Mozzer and the others only indulged in the distraction on their twenty [[Standard minute|minute]] breaks.<ref name="TROS VD" />

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IX|Mozzer's appearance}}</ref> Mozzer stood under the [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]'' when [[Resistance pilot]] [[Temmin Wexley]] reported to [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] that contact had been lost with the Resistance agents [[Mission to Pasaana (Resistance)|sent]] to the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]]. He was later in the base's command center when Organa left in order to reach out to her son [[Ben Solo]] through [[the Force]]. After Organa's [[death]], Mozzer attended a meeting and stood next to the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] while General [[Poe Dameron]] laid out his plan to [[Battle of Exegol|attack]] the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] on the [[planet]] [[Exegol]].<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Wizzich Mozzer was uncharacteristically inquisitive and independent for a Cyclorrian, and was the most interested in interacting with non-Cyclorrian personnel. He had [[Color|gray]] skin and blue compound [[eye]]s.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
Mozzer wore a [[pheromone scent mask]] and a brown patterened [[scarf]] with a brown jacket over a light brown [[jumpsuit]] and black [[boot]]s.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wizzich Mozzer was portrayed by ''[[Star Wars]]'' veteran [[Warwick Davis]]<ref name="WarwickTwitter">{{Twitter|WarwickADavis|status/1210224024388874240|[[Warwick Davis]]|quote=That is indeed one of the characters I play in [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker]]|archivefile=File:WizzichMozzer-WarwickDavisTwitter.png}}</ref> in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
